description: This file defines the FunctionPrefix class in the PhpSpreadsheet library, which manages prefixing Excel functions with '_xlfn' or '_xlws' as needed, and provides utility methods for applying these prefixes to function names in formulas.

classes.name: FunctionPrefix
classes.description: Utility class to add appropriate Excel function prefixes based on function support and versioning.

methods.name: addXlfnPrefix
methods.description: Prefixes function names with '_xlfn' where required based on the regular expression.

methods.name: addXlwsPrefix
methods.description: Prefixes function names with '_xlws' where required based on the regular expression.

methods.name: addFunctionPrefix
methods.description: Applies both XLFN and XLWS prefixes to the function string.

methods.name: addFunctionPrefixStripEquals
methods.description: Strips the leading '=' sign from the function string and applies prefixes.
